title: Q1 orchestration map: aligning hosted endpoints with model fleet priorities
creator: Priya Nair
description: This ticket defines the quarter-level orchestration map to synchronize hosted endpoint prioritization with model-fleet onboarding and retirement decisions. Goal: produce a tracked, executable plan that links OKRs to specific endpoint capacity commitments, model upgrade windows, and fallbacks. Deliverables: a prioritized endpoint-to-model mapping, canary scheduling guidance, gating criteria for model swaps, and a compact stakeholder communication cadence. This work spans Console, Runtime, and Customer Success for Q1 planning and handoff to engineering squads.
updates: 2025-11-11: Kickoff with runtime and infra leads. Agreed to target three endpoint cohorts (low-latency, high-throughput, experimental) for Q1 alignment.
2025-11-14: Draft mapping completed — attached table linking endpoints to preferred model variants and fallback tiers. Shared with Design for API contract review.
2025-11-18: Product/CS sync — identified two anchor customers for early validation; CS will schedule interviews week of Nov 24.

2025-11-20: Trade-off discussion: aggressive model rotation reduces unit cost but increases regression risk. Decision: require regression guardrail pass and sampled traffic canary before any model swap.
2025-11-22: Dependencies logged for kernel scheduling improvements (ENG-1984) and autoscaling policy change (ENG-3012). Engineering requires final mapping by 2025-12-08 to scope sprint work.
2025-11-24: PM review — accepted rough plan; next steps: bake canary cadence into rollout docs and create rollout runbook. Assigned PM owners for each endpoint cohort.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Prioritized endpoint-to-model mapping published and linked in Confluence
A2: Canary schedule and gating checklist created for each cohort
A3: Dependencies and sprint requests submitted to engineering with clear scope and timelines
A4: Stakeholder communication template and cadence agreed (weekly digest + go/no-go sync)
A5: Two anchor customers committed to participate in early validation for the high-throughput cohort
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Model swap causes unseen regressions in edge cases. Mitigation: require automated eval suite + targeted prompt set validated by Research before canary launch.
Risk: Autoscaling changes may not land in time. Mitigation: fall back to conservative commit windows and reserve burst capacity for high-throughput cohort.
Risk: Anchor customers decline participation. Mitigation: expand candidate list and offer white-glove engineering support for early validation runs.
rollout_plan: Milestone 1 (2025-12-08): Final mapping and sprint requests submitted
Milestone 2 (2025-12-22): Canary schedules and gating checklists approved
Milestone 3 (2026-01-10): Engineering alignment complete; rollouts queued in sprint planner
Milestone 4 (2026-01-15): Soft launch of first cohort canary to 1% traffic
Milestone 5 (2026-01-29): Evaluate canary metrics and decide on ramp or rollback
notes: Trade-offs: We emphasize predictability for enterprise customers over fastest-possible cost reductions this quarter.
Open question: whether to permit simultaneous canaries for multiple endpoints on the same GPU pool; runtime team to advise on isolation needs.
Follow-up: schedule architecture review with Runtime and Infra teams to finalize capacity reservations (target by 2025-12-02).
